breakdown.description: The prompt assumes equal span implies equal force sharing, but the load split in parallel bars depends on the relative axial stiffnesses AE/L.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly distributed the load based on relative axial stiffnesses (AE/L), not equally. It used the compatibility and equilibrium equations to find P1 = 11538.46 N and P2 = 18461.54 N, which reflects the stiffness-proportional load sharing rather than the incorrect equal split suggested in the incomplete prompt.

breakdown.description: The prompt adds the two bar elongations to get the plate displacement, even though parallel bars between rigid plates undergo the same elongation.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that both bars undergo the same (common) elongation of 0.31 mm, consistent with the parallel bar compatibility condition. It did not add the two elongations together to get a plate displacement; instead, it verified that both bars elongate equally and reported a single common elongation value.
